notes: HOLLY'S VIGIL on the Ox Road, round 2 after review b4 (REDO: a solid bowl read as a modern grill): an open strap-iron cage (a cresset) on a tripod, its rim seen from above with the coals heaped in it, six bars tapering to a foot ring with the glow between them; the flame about 1.5x the basket, three tongues whose tops climb and break off as rising licks on their own phases across four frames at 8 fps (hard pixels, torch and blood ramps, no glow). Modelled in the wagons' camera (.scratch/kit/ox-vigil.mjs cageBase), the still polished palette-held by edit_image_pro_flash; the flame drawn over it by rule (flames2), an effect on the still. Its light is LIGHTS.mh_vigil_brazier (terrain.js). Pixels unscaled.
